sources.title: AP Computer Science A Course and Exam Description (Effective Fall 2025)
AP Computer Science A Clarifications and Corrections to the Course and Exam Description
sources.revision: 2026-01-29 PDF revision (career-preparation wording implemented in August 2025; resource links and Progress Check edits announced for summer 2026; all 73 learning objectives unchanged)

mappings.summary: Design and express sequential everyday algorithms in plain prose or diagrams.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no topic for planning an everyday sequence in prose or a diagram. A standalone planning topic has no evidenced tuple.

mappings.summary: Describe how source code is authored, checked by a compiler, and executed, including IDE support.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no compiler or IDE topic to explain the path from source code to execution. A standalone compilation topic has no evidenced tuple.

mappings.summary: Distinguish compile-time syntax errors, logic errors found by testing, run-time failures, and exceptions.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no compilation, testing, or exception topics for distinguishing syntax errors, logic errors, and run-time failures.

mappings.summary: Choose between primitive and reference data-type categories for a stated problem requirement.
mappings.rationale: Variables identifies named storage, but the seed has no data-type concepts for choosing primitive versus reference types.

mappings.summary: Declare typed primitive variables (int, double, boolean) to store numeric and truth values.
mappings.rationale: Seed includes Variables, but omits Data Types, primitive categories, and Java int/double/boolean constraints.

mappings.summary: Write and trace console output statements using System.out.print and System.out.println.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no output topic for writing or tracing System.out.print and System.out.println calls.

mappings.summary: Construct and evaluate string literals including escape sequences for quotes, backslashes, and newlines.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no Strings topic to cover literal syntax or escapes for quotes, backslashes, and newlines.

mappings.summary: Write and evaluate int and double arithmetic expressions using +, -, *, /, %, precedence rules, and integer division by zero.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no arithmetic expressions or operator topics for precedence, numeric operations, and integer division.

mappings.summary: Initialize and update variables with = expressions, including null references, and trace stored values.
mappings.rationale: Seed includes Variables, but omits assignment operators, Expressions, and null references.

mappings.summary: Write Java code that reads input supplied to a program.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no input or I/O topic to support writing Java code that reads data.

mappings.summary: Apply explicit (int) and (double) casts and implicit widening in arithmetic, including truncation and rounding patterns.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no numeric-conversion topic to distinguish explicit casts, widening, and truncation.

mappings.summary: Identify integer overflow when 32-bit int calculations exceed Integer.MIN_VALUE through Integer.MAX_VALUE.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no model of fixed-width integers or the bounds that determine when int arithmetic overflows.

mappings.summary: Explain floating-point round-off errors caused by finite double representation precision.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no topic for how finite double precision causes rounding errors.

mappings.summary: Write and trace compound assignment (+=, -=, *=, /=, %=) and postfix ++ and -- variable updates.
mappings.rationale: Variables does not document arithmetic assignment, postfix increments or decrements, or the effect of tracing those updates.

mappings.summary: Read library and API documentation to determine a class's data attributes, methods, and package grouping.

disputes.rationale: Seed models Classes depending on Objects, reversing blueprint-to-instance conceptual dependency.

mappings.rationale: Seed includes Classes and Objects, but omits API specifications, libraries, and Encapsulation.

mappings.summary: Document code behavior, preconditions, and postconditions with line, block, and Javadoc comments ignored by the compiler.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no comments or Javadoc topic for documenting behavior and method contracts. A standalone documentation topic has no evidenced tuple.

mappings.summary: Select the matching method to invoke from documentation and method parameter signatures.
mappings.rationale: Seed includes Functions, but omits method signatures, parameter types, and procedural abstraction documentation.

mappings.summary: Explain method invocation rules for void and non-void methods, call-by-value arguments, overloading, and control flow return.
mappings.rationale: Seed includes Functions, but omits void/non-void returns, call-by-value arguments, and overloading.

mappings.summary: Invoke static class methods with the class name and dot operator and trace their return values.
mappings.rationale: The seed has Classes and Functions, but no static-method topic for calls made through a class name.

mappings.summary: Write and evaluate expressions calling Math.abs, Math.pow, Math.sqrt, and scaled Math.random ranges.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no numerical library topic for Math functions or transforming the range of Math.random results.

mappings.summary: Explain classes as object blueprints, Object as Java's universal superclass, and conceptual superclass/subclass relationships without designing hierarchies.

disputes.rationale: Seed includes Abstract Classes is_a Classes; runtime traverses is_a as a prerequisite even though Abstract Classes is out of AP CSA scope.
Seed treats Objects as prerequisite to Classes.
Seed links Inheritance to Classes, whereas CED 1.12.A.2 excludes designing inheritance.

mappings.rationale: Seed includes Classes and Objects, but omits Object root inheritance while linking out-of-scope Inheritance and taxonomic Abstract Classes is_a Classes.

mappings.summary: Declare variables of reference types that hold references to objects.
mappings.rationale: Seed includes Objects and Variables, but omits Java reference-type declarations.

mappings.summary: Match a constructor call to its signature among potentially overloaded constructors.
mappings.rationale: The Classes and Objects tuple leaves constructor signatures and overload selection unspecified.

mappings.summary: Declare reference variables typed for objects or initialized to null.
mappings.rationale: Seed includes Objects and Variables, but omits reference variable declarations and null.

mappings.summary: Instantiate objects with new, passing constructor arguments by value and tracing constructor execution.
mappings.rationale: Seed includes Classes and Objects, but omits constructors, new instantiation, and call-by-value initialization.

mappings.summary: Invoke instance methods on object references with the dot operator, trace outcomes, and recognize NullPointerException on null targets.
mappings.rationale: Seed includes Classes, Functions, and Objects without instance-method dispatch or NullPointerException.

mappings.summary: Create immutable String objects, concatenate strings with primitive or toString values, and trace results.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no Strings topic for immutability, concatenation, or conversion to text.

mappings.summary: Invoke String methods (length, substring, indexOf, equals, compareTo) and recognize out-of-bounds index exceptions.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no string operations to trace substring extraction, search, comparison, or invalid indexes.

mappings.summary: Express everyday algorithms combining sequence, conditional choice, and repetition in prose or diagrams.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no control-flow topic linking sequence, decisions, and repetition for everyday algorithms.

mappings.summary: Write and evaluate Boolean expressions that compare primitive values or reference identity with == and !=, and test numeric ordering with <, >, <=, and >=.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no relational operators or Boolean expressions for comparing numeric values or checking object identity.

mappings.summary: Implement and trace one-way if and two-way if-else branching statements.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no selection topic that shows a Boolean guard, an if branch, or an else branch.

mappings.summary: Implement and trace nested if and multiway if-else-if selection chains.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no conditional logic that could support nested choices or else-if chains.

mappings.summary: Construct and trace compound Boolean logic with !, &&, and ||, operator precedence, and short-circuit evaluation.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no Boolean operator or evaluation topic for compound conditions and short-circuiting.

mappings.summary: Prove Boolean equivalence using truth tables and De Morgan's laws.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no Boolean equivalence, truth-table, or De Morgan's law topic.

mappings.summary: Compare object references for alias identity (==, !=, null) versus attribute equality (equals).
mappings.rationale: Seed includes Objects, but omits Boolean comparisons, == alias checks, and equals.

mappings.summary: Recognize problems needing iteration and diagnose zero-iteration conditions, infinite loops, and off-by-one bugs.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no iteration topic for deciding when to loop or identifying zero iterations and termination errors.

mappings.summary: Write and trace while loop repetition governed by a pre-checked Boolean condition.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no while-loop topic for tracing a pre-checked condition and its repeated body.

mappings.summary: Write and trace for loops with header initialization, guard, and update, and convert between for and while.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no for-loop topic for tracing initialization, condition, and update or comparing the equivalent while loop.

mappings.summary: Implement and trace standard non-collection algorithms for divisibility, integer digits, counts, min/max, and sums or averages.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no numeric iteration topic for algorithms on digits, divisibility, counts, extrema, or sums.

mappings.summary: Implement and trace iterative algorithms that search, count substrings, and reverse strings.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no Strings or iteration topic for searching substrings, counting matches, or reversing text.

mappings.summary: Implement and trace nested loops where the inner loop finishes completely on each outer iteration.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no nested-loop topic that shows how the inner loop runs during each outer step.

mappings.summary: Trace loops to count statement executions and compare iterative run-time efficiency informally.
mappings.rationale: The seed names Binary Search and Merge Sort, but has no statement-count evidence for comparing the efficiency of iterative code.

mappings.summary: Plan class-based programs in prose or diagrams specifying data attributes, procedural decomposition, and method behaviors.

disputes.rationale: Taxonomic Abstract Classes is_a Classes edge touches Classes.

mappings.rationale: Seed includes Classes, Functions, and Objects across disconnected components, but omits Encapsulation, design diagrams, and decomposition.

mappings.summary: Analyze software reliability, beneficial and harmful societal, economic, and cultural impacts, and open-source versus proprietary licensing.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no reliability, software testing, social impact, or licensing topic. The standalone ethics requirements have no evidenced tuple.

mappings.summary: Apply public and private access modifiers to classes, instance fields, constructors, and methods to enforce encapsulation.
mappings.rationale: Seed includes Classes without Encapsulation or public/private access control.

mappings.summary: Declare private instance fields, initialize object state in constructors (copying mutable arguments), and apply default constructor rules.
mappings.rationale: Seed includes Classes, Objects, and Variables without constructor initialization or default field values.

mappings.summary: Author void mutators and typed non-void accessor or computation methods using primitive parameters passed by value and return flow.
mappings.rationale: Seed includes Classes, Functions, and Variables without accessor/mutator definitions or return rules.

mappings.summary: Write and trace methods taking and returning object references, observing aliasing, mutable state effects, and same-class private access.
mappings.rationale: Seed includes Classes, Functions, and Objects without reference parameter/return aliasing.

mappings.summary: Write static class methods that operate on static state and class helpers without direct instance state access.
mappings.rationale: Classes and Functions supply no evidence for writing static helpers or using class state independently of an instance.

mappings.summary: Declare shared static class variables and final constants with appropriate visibility.
mappings.rationale: Classes and Variables supply no evidence about shared static fields, visibility, or final constants.

mappings.summary: Determine variable visibility across blocks, constructors, methods, and parameters, including local shadowing of instance fields.
mappings.rationale: Seed includes Functions and Variables without Scope or shadowing rules.

mappings.summary: Use this within instance methods and constructors to refer to or pass the active receiver object (unavailable in static methods).
mappings.rationale: Objects does not specify the Java this expression or how methods refer to and pass their receiver.

mappings.summary: Explain personal privacy hazards from collecting and retaining user data and a developer's responsibility to safeguard privacy.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no topic on collecting or retaining personal data or the responsibility to protect it. A standalone privacy topic has no evidenced tuple.

mappings.summary: Identify risks from algorithmic bias, biased collection practices, and incomplete or inaccurate data sets.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no topic for biased collection or incomplete and inaccurate data. A standalone data-quality topic has no evidenced tuple.

mappings.summary: Evaluate whether a data set is fit to answer a specific problem without invalid extrapolation.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no topic for assessing whether a data set answers a question or supports extrapolation. A standalone fitness judgment has no evidenced tuple.

mappings.summary: Represent everyday data-set workflows and tabular or charted structures in prose or diagrams prior to coding.
mappings.rationale: Arrays models a programming structure, with no topic for using everyday charts, tables, or diagrams to plan a data workflow. That planning topic has no evidenced tuple.

mappings.summary: Create fixed-size 1D primitive or object arrays via new or initializer lists, index with [], check .length, and handle bounds errors.
mappings.rationale: Seed includes Arrays as a root component without Java array indexing, .length, or bounds errors.

mappings.summary: Traverse 1D arrays with indexed for/while loops and enhanced for loops, distinguishing element-variable copies from object state updates.
mappings.rationale: Seed includes Arrays without Loops, Iteration, or enhanced-for traversal rules.

mappings.summary: Implement and trace 1D array algorithms for extrema, totals, quantifiers, counts, adjacent pairs, duplicates, shifts or rotations, and reversal.
mappings.rationale: Seed includes Arrays without loop constructs or standard array algorithms.

mappings.summary: Read persistent text files using java.io.File, Scanner, throws IOException, hasNext/next methods, literal String.split, and close.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no file input or string processing topics for reading and splitting persistent text and handling IOException.

mappings.summary: Use immutable Integer and Double wrappers with their primitives through boxing and unboxing. Use parseInt and parseDouble to parse strings into primitive numbers.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no wrapper or parsing concepts for boxing Integer and Double values or converting text into primitives.

mappings.summary: Create parameterized ArrayList<E> collections from java.util and trace size, add, get, set, and remove.

disputes.rationale: Seed links Generics to Polymorphism rather than parameterized ArrayList<E> usage.

mappings.rationale: Arrays provides a fixed-length collection concept, with no parameterized ArrayList or evidence of its insertion, access, and removal operations.

mappings.summary: Traverse ArrayList collections safely, handling index shifts on deletion, IndexOutOfBoundsException, and ConcurrentModificationException.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no ArrayList traversal topic for coping with index shifts or collection modification exceptions.

mappings.summary: Implement and trace ArrayList manipulation algorithms (including insertion and deletion) and parallel multi-collection traversals.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no ArrayList algorithms for insertion, deletion, or processing multiple corresponding collections.

mappings.summary: Represent rectangular 2D arrays as arrays of row arrays, index via [row][col], inspect row and column lengths, and handle bounds errors.
mappings.rationale: Arrays has no edge or topic that identifies rectangular 2D arrays, row and column lengths, or row-column indexing.

mappings.summary: Traverse 2D arrays in row-major, column-major, or custom orders using nested indexed or enhanced for loops.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no 2D array or nested-loop topic for row-major, column-major, or custom traversals.

mappings.summary: Implement and trace 2D array algorithms across full grids, specific rows or columns, or subsections.
mappings.rationale: The seed has no topic for algorithms over 2D rows, columns, grids, or subregions.

mappings.summary: Implement and trace linear search across 1D arrays, ArrayList instances, and row-by-row 2D arrays.
mappings.rationale: Binary Search is the only search topic tied to Arrays. The seed has no sequential scan across arrays, ArrayList, or a 2D grid.

mappings.summary: Trace each pass of iterative selection sort and insertion sort on arrays and ArrayList collections.
mappings.rationale: Merge Sort is the only sorting topic in the seed. Selection and insertion sort passes over arrays or ArrayList are absent.

mappings.summary: Trace recursive methods with base cases, per-call local variables, and iterative equivalence without authoring recursive code.
mappings.rationale: Seed models Recursion depending on Functions, but omits base cases, stack frames, iterative equivalence, and tracing-only scope.

mappings.summary: Trace recursive traversals over strings, arrays, and ArrayList collections.
mappings.rationale: Seed includes Arrays and Recursion across separate disconnected components, omitting Strings and ArrayList recursive traversals.

mappings.summary: Trace each step of iterative or recursive binary search on sorted collections and compare efficiency to linear search.
mappings.rationale: Seed connects Binary Search to Arrays in its Arrays component while Recursion sits in a separate disconnected component, omitting recursive binary search, ArrayList, and Linear Search comparison.

mappings.summary: Trace recursive divide-and-merge steps of merge sort on arrays and ArrayList collections.
mappings.rationale: Seed links Merge Sort to Recursion in the Algorithms component, omitting the prerequisite link to Arrays and omitting ArrayList sorting.

unresolved_disputes.rationale: Seed includes Abstract Classes is_a Classes; runtime traverses is_a as a prerequisite even though Abstract Classes is out of AP CSA scope.
Seed treats Objects as prerequisite to Classes.
Seed links Inheritance to Classes, whereas CED 1.12.A.2 excludes designing inheritance.
Seed models Classes depending on Objects, reversing blueprint-to-instance conceptual dependency.
Taxonomic Abstract Classes is_a Classes edge touches Classes.
Seed links Generics to Polymorphism rather than parameterized ArrayList<E> usage.

outside_course.reason: Unit 4 collection objectives use 1D and 2D arrays and ArrayList. AVL tree balancing requires a separate tree representation and rotations.

Unit 3 covers writing concrete Java classes and methods. The Abstract Classes is_a Classes tuple describes a subtype relationship, and abstract class design falls beyond those class-creation objectives.
CED 4.17.B traces binary search on an ordered collection. Binary search trees instead maintain ordering in linked tree nodes.
Unit 3 requires routine class design using fields, constructors, and methods. Named reusable object-oriented design patterns are outside that class-design scope.
Unit 4 traces traversal, search, sorting, and recursion on course collections. Dynamic programming adds caching and reuse of overlapping subproblems.
Generic type authoring and polymorphism-bound generics are outside AP CSA (4.8.A uses parameterized ArrayList<E> only).
Unit 4 traversal objectives use indexed data. Graph traversal requires following links between vertices.
Unit 4 uses 1D and 2D arrays and ArrayList. Vertex and edge structure is a separate data model.
Unit 4 specifies arrays and ArrayList as containers. Hash tables add key-based lookup and collision handling.
CED 1.12.A.2 explicitly excludes designing and implementing inheritance hierarchies from Fall 2025 AP CSA.
Unit 3 covers writing Java classes and methods. Interface declarations and implementation contracts fall beyond these class-creation objectives.
Unit 4 covers 1D and 2D arrays and ArrayList. Pointer-linked nodes and link traversal belong to a separate collection representation.
CED 2.6.B covers Java references and object equivalence. Explicit memory addresses and address arithmetic go beyond those references.
CED 1.12.A.2 excludes inheritance hierarchy design and implementation. Subtype polymorphism and dynamic dispatch are beyond the required uses of classes and objects.
Unit 4 covers 1D and 2D arrays and ArrayList. Tree nodes and branches form a separate collection model.
